title: 加州地下水補注系統 GWRS
summary: GWRS將膜處理與UV/H₂O₂後的水送至補注系統。本課追蹤水質障壁、補注能力與地下水傳輸，避免把地下水視為無限儲槽。

steps.title: 微濾前處理：膜通量與有效膜面積：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Microfiltration pretreatment: Membrane flux and effective area: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 微濾前處理：膜通量與有效膜面積 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Microfiltration pretreatment: Membrane flux and effective area and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 膜通量是單位膜面積的產水速率；產水流量固定時，增加可用膜面積可降低通量負擔。本單元在「微濾前處理」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Membrane flux is permeate flow per area; additional available membrane area reduces flux loading at fixed production. Examine this relationship at microfiltration pretreatment.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：產水 Qp=96 m³/h、膜面積 A=2400 m²。公式 J=1000Qp/A；代入 1000*96/2400 = 40 L/(m²·h)。適用邊界：淨產水通量；應另扣反洗停機，非任何膜產品允許值。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: permeate Qp=96 m³/h and membrane area A=2400 m². Formula J=1000Qp/A; substitution 1000*96/2400 = 40 L/(m²·h). Boundary: Net production flux; backwash downtime is separate and this is not a membrane product limit.
steps.failure: 未扣停用膜列會低估剩餘膜列的真實通量。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: Counting offline trains understates flux on the remaining membranes. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 以產水總表與各膜列面積核對，另記反洗時間。在離線場景為「微濾前處理」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Reconcile total permeate with each train area and separately log backwash time. Build an offline evidence table for microfiltration pretreatment; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

steps.titleEn: RO water split: Reverse-osmosis water recovery: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 逆滲透水量分流：逆滲透水回收率 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of RO water split: Reverse-osmosis water recovery and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 回收率把進水分為產水與濃水；提高回收通常也提高濃水鹽度與結垢風險，不能只追求產水百分比。本單元在「逆滲透水量分流」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recovery divides feed into permeate and concentrate; higher recovery usually raises concentrate salinity and scaling risk, so production percentage alone is insufficient. Examine this relationship at RO water split.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：進水 Qf=100 m³/h、產水 Qp=75 m³/h。公式 Y=100Qp/Qf；代入 100*75/100 = 75 %。適用邊界：穩態體積流量且忽略微小密度差；未預測結垢。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: feed Qf=100 m³/h and permeate Qp=75 m³/h. Formula Y=100Qp/Qf; substitution 100*75/100 = 75 %. Boundary: Steady volumetric flow with small density differences neglected; scaling is not predicted.

steps.objective: 辨識 UV/AOP光量子模型：紫外線光量概念 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of UV/AOP fluence submodel: Ultraviolet fluence concept and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 均勻光場下光量為強度乘照射時間；真實反應器須考慮水質透光率、遮蔽與停留分布。本單元在「UV/AOP光量子模型」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: In a uniform field, fluence equals intensity times exposure time; real reactors require transmittance, shadowing and residence distributions. Examine this relationship at UV/AOP fluence submodel.

steps.instruction: 泵的輸入功率須供應流量的位能增加及損失；效率下降會使同一輸送服務耗電增加。本單元在「輸送與注入能耗」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Pump input must provide the hydraulic energy increase and losses; lower efficiency increases electricity for the same conveyance service. Examine this relationship at conveyance and injection energy.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：Q=0.10 m³/s、H=12 m、總效率η=0.72、ρ=1000 kg/m³。公式 P=ρgQH/(1000η)；代入 1000*9.81*0.10*12/(1000*0.72) = 16.35 kW。適用邊界：穩態不可壓縮流，H含管損；不涵蓋起動、水錘與汽蝕。

knowledge.text: 以同一標準建立又驗證模型會隱藏校正偏差。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
knowledge.textEn: Calibrating and validating with the same standard hides bias. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.titleEn: Verification and practice
knowledge.text: 先點選「配對井水與儀表樣品」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把樣品原讀值改成16.2，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 15.4 sensor unit。與基準 13.4 sensor unit比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
knowledge.textEn: Select the paired well-water and sensor samples measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only raw sample to16.2 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 15.4 sensor unit. Compare with baseline 13.4 sensor unit and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

quiz.question: 哪一項正確描述本步應診斷的失效原因？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement correctly describes the failure to diagnose?
options: 以同一標準建立又驗證模型會隱藏校正偏差。
看到結果符合預期就可省略條件、單位與原始資料。
單點校正可以證明整個量程都沒有誤差。
optionsEn: Calibrating and validating with the same standard hides bias.
An expected result allows conditions, units and raw data to be omitted.
One-point calibration proves the entire range is error-free.
quiz.explanation: 以同一標準建立又驗證模型會隱藏校正偏差。 用第二標準獨立驗證校正後殘差並記錄日期與溫度。在離線場景為「配對井水與儀表樣品」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
quiz.explanationEn: Calibrating and validating with the same standard hides bias. Use a second standard to verify corrected residuals independently and record date and temperature. Build an offline evidence table for paired well-water and sensor samples; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

scope: 公開原理與資料支持的原創教學。算例中的輸入為明示教學假設，非該設施實測或操作設定。此處任務在離線模型完成，不能作為現場設計、飲用水合格或設備操作許可。
scopeEn: Original teaching based on public principles and sources. Numerical inputs are explicit teaching assumptions, not site measurements or operating setpoints. Tasks use offline models and do not certify field design, potable-water compliance or equipment operation.

workedExample.title: 教學算例
workedExample.text: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：產水 Qp=96 m³/h、膜面積 A=2400 m²。公式 J=1000Qp/A；代入 1000*96/2400 = 40 L/(m²·h)。適用邊界：淨產水通量；應另扣反洗停機，非任何膜產品允許值。
workedExample.textEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: permeate Qp=96 m³/h and membrane area A=2400 m². Formula J=1000Qp/A; substitution 1000*96/2400 = 40 L/(m²·h). Boundary: Net production flux; backwash downtime is separate and this is not a membrane product limit.
